notes.title: Update Six: Topless Beach (Adults ONLY!)
notes.content:
[h1]Will she DARE to BARE it all?[/h1]
Sexy President's latest 21+ update is now live, adding several sensual new choices to the beach bikini contest segment of the game, including the ability for Sexy President to go topless!

This update also contains several small bug fixes, changes up certain dialogue sequences, and updates key art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599501/b941f9623590bc65b4ee27f0c99e3c8361579add.png[/img]

[h1]The Plot:[/h1]
As soon as Sexy President learns of a glamorous beach bikini contest being judged by prominent world leaders, including her ex, The King, she hops on the first plane she can find and fly's out to beautiful Hawaii.  But when her arch-rival, busty bad girl Victoria Vanderblunt, Duchess of Björktown enters the fray, things take a turn for the strange and unexpected!

Now it's up to you to guide Sexy to a first place finish by any means necessary.  The competition is stiff, but so are you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599501/36d08c2cc27a8ac0e7737fa3091be6298b78e8eb.png[/img]

[h1]More Free DLC Drops in February[/h1]
This is the sixth in a series of updates to Sexy President, all released free for owners of the game.  As always, please feel free to leave any comments or suggestions on what you'd like to see added in future updates, either here, [b]@DoctorSpunk[/b] on Twitter, or on the Sexy President Steam Community Hub.

[u][b][i]Please enjoy, happy new year, and thanks for playing![/i][/b][/u]

notes.title: Update Four: Latex
notes.content:
[i]Sexy President's [/i]latest update, [b]Latex[/b], is now available for download!  This is the fourth in a series of free DLC patches, each focused on a different theme.

[b]Latex [/b]is a smaller update, especially when compared to last Friday's download, but does include several important fixes to the beach bikini contest, including a modified ending, with more opportunity for player choice.

A brand new outfit has also been added: [i]a latex catsuit the president wears underneath her astronaut gear![/i]  She can be seen wearing it during the crash back to earth scene, following Hambone's rescue.  Stay tuned for more intimate situations and color options involving this shiny new outfit in the weeks to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599501/14c2c67548ab82b85366e9225864d2b91a37be0a.png[/img]

As always, please feel free to comment on what features/content you'd like to see added in future updates, either here, via Twitter, or on the Sexy President Community Hub.
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Two: Rivals
notes.content:
[i]Sexy President's [/i]second update, [b]Rivals[/b], went live last night and is available for download!  This is the second in a series of weekly upgrades to Sexy President, each focusing on a different theme, and all released free to owners of the game.

Rivals lays the groundwork for an overhauled arousal system, and includes a new Story Chapter which picks up following the journey to space introduced in the [b]Blastoff [/b]update.

This week's content is mostly focused on deepening your rivalry with the King, and continuing to flesh out the players relationship with Sexy President. Additionally, several minor bug fixes and performance updates are included.

[b]A Quick Programming Note: [/b][i]this week's download was originally themed around an erotic beach bikini contest, however due to pending content approval issues, said update has been pushed out approximately two weeks.  Here's a quick preview of things to come:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599501/0c59576b2271ccbb55fe947cbd8f30ca8d75cefe.png[/img]

As always, please feel free to leave any comments or suggestions on what features/content you'd like to see added in future updates, either here, via Twitter, or on the Sexy President Community Hub.

notes.title: Update One: BLASTOFF!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that the [b]Blastoff [/b]content pack has officially gone live!  This is the first in a series of 5-10 weekly updates to [i]Sexy President[/i], each focusing on a different theme, and all released 100% free for owners of the game.

[b]Blastoff [/b]features three brand new chapters to play through, including a death defying rescue mission to outer space, complete with our most dynamic animated visuals yet!

An entire in game day has been added, with the majority of new content contained between the end of your post UN discussion with Larry, and your flight to San Francisco.  A host of small game-play and image tweaks are also included, along with various minor text changes.

I look forward to continuing this journey, and thank you all for your continued support!  As always, please feel free to leave any comments or suggestions on what features/content you'd like to see added in future updates, either here, Twitter, or on the [i]Sexy President[/i] Community Hub.

Coming up next week, things are about to get wet and wild with [b]'UPDATE TWO: BIKINI BEACH BABES!'[/b]
